conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Alex Carter from the IRS Tax Relief Center. I'm calling about your recent federal tax filings.
Oh, um, hi. Is there a problem with my taxes?

According to our records, you have an outstanding tax balance from last year. But don't worry, since you're recently out of college, you qualify for a special debt forgiveness program through the IRS.
I didn't realize I owed anything. Can you tell me more about this program?
Absolutely. It's a one-time settlement opportunity. If you enroll today, your entire balance can be reduced by almost 80%. Otherwise, the full amount plus penalties will remain due.
That sounds helpful, but I'm really confused. I thought I paid all my taxes already.
It's common to miss things, especially with recent graduates. The IRS does not take this lightly, but that's why we're offering this chance before formal action is taken against you.
What kind of formal action?
If this isn't resolved today, you could be subject to wage garnishment or even legal proceedings, which could impact your credit. We want to help you avoid that.
Oh, wow. I don't want any legal trouble. What do I need to do?
To lock in your tax relief, there's a mandatory legal processing fee of $499. Once that's paid, we can initiate your application and halt any further action.
I don't know if I have that much. Can I pay by credit card?
For security, the IRS only accepts payment through direct wire transfer or government-approved prepaid cards. I can guide you through this.
How do I get a prepaid card?

You can buy IRS-approved prepaid cards at any major pharmacy or retail store, like Walgreens or Walmart. Once you have the card, call me back at this number, and I'll walk you through submitting the code.
Okay, so I just go to the store and buy a prepaid card for $499?
Correct. Please make sure to purchase a GreenDot MoneyPak or Vanilla Reload card. Keep your receipt, and don't share the details with anyone else for your protection.
Is this definitely going to stop the IRS from coming after me?
Yes, once you complete the payment, your file is flagged for settlement, and all legal actions are suspended. It's important you do this today, as the IRS deadline is midnight.
I guess I don't have a choice. Do I bring anything else when I go to the store?
Just your ID and enough funds for the card. Please call me as soon as you have it so we can submit your application immediately.
Okay, I'll go now. What's the number I call when I have the card?
Call me directly at 1-800-555-0199, extension 203. I'll be waiting for your call so we can get this resolved before any penalties are processed.
